scope: source handoff only, root owns registered fixture/helper/RED

oracle.scope: One-level collapse preserves existing59 convention. It does not establish multilevel diverging semantics.
oracle.checks: All input samples must yield identical hue and mix; actual one-swatch legend must compile without 0/0; probe complete ramp and quantizer separately
oracle.thirdParty: D3 scaleQuantize([0,1],[0.5]) yields one effective midpoint position; scaleLinear([0,1],[18,100])(.5)=59

multilevel.qualification: Actual resolved colors may coincide for specially equal theme colors; count describes native palette positions, not universal distinct RGB guarantee
multilevel.reason: n quantized percentages on each side; minimum18 is nonzero, so opposite midpoint hues do not merge
